prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic original artistic interpretation (not a photograph) of Castillo de Colomares in Benalmadena, Spain, at night. Tourist viewpoint: the monument grounds, from the lower terrace looking up. Frame: the fairy-tale monument centered — a jumble of towers and spires mixing Neo-Gothic, Neo-Romanesque, Neo-Byzantine and Mudejar styles; the stone ship of La Nina represented at the very top of the structure; gardens and cypress trees framing the monument with the scattered lights of the Costa del Sol beyond. Night light: soft floodlighting on the monument facades, gardens dark, clear sky, 21 degrees C, light breeze; illumination is an artistic interpretation. Main subject centered to survive a 4:5 center crop. No identifiable people, no legible logos, no text, lettering or signs anywhere. Keep the lower third clean and uncluttered.
